plan: My value for the item is $42. To maximize profit, I should bid below my value but high enough to potentially win. Bidding exactly $42 would yield zero profit if I win. To avoid dominated strategies, I consider bids just below $42, as bidding above is irrational. I will bid $35 to balance competitiveness and profit potential, considering that other bidders may also bid near their values.

To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below $6, ensuring any win results in a positive profit. Given no history and to avoid dominated strategies, I will bid $5.9, which is just below my value to maximize potential profit if the others bid lower.
